limitations: The same established 16 software projects and separate profile repository were refreshed; the entire account inventory was not reenumerated.

All metadata and default-branch heads were freshly checked. Fifteen software heads are identical to the pinned prior histories; counts and original enumeration evidence are retained. Anti-REA Forge advanced by two ancestor-verified commits and the profile repository by one, giving 34 and 50 reachable commits respectively. The 50 profile commits are a prepublication count.

The latest normal releases of AI-Memory-Book, ModelDock and Jev MCP were rechecked and their displayed versions are unchanged. Anti-REA Forge and LLM Handshake have no latest normal release; their pinned README and package metadata were read to verify displayed versions. Anti-REA Forge's updated README still declares v0.10.0. No upstream or project tests were run.
User-facing snapshot labels show the calendar date only; exact UTC observation timestamps are retained here as evidence.
